summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate of Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Built a voice-controlled robotic arm on Jetson and Arduino with a 5.2x inference speedup and 100% pick reliability, plus signal processing pipelines (wavelet denoising, ZoeDepth depth estimation) for crack analysis. Writes production-level C/C++ and Python across embedded, GPU, and distributed systems, translating raw sensor and audio signals into real-time robotic and typed output.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation on the BraTS 2020 MRI dataset with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU.
Led a cross cultural team of 7 as the sole ML experienced student, restructuring task distribution to deliver the full pipeline within a 6 week window.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low frequency noise, combined with optimized homography stitching to achieve a PSNR of 86.
Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and ZoeDepth depth estimation (±8% error).

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a tap detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding, resolving sensor jitter through calibration.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice controlled, vision guided robotic pick and place system across a Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO server, and Jetson+Arduino controller with TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup) for visual servoing and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact aware grasping.
Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at roughly 11.5s end to end latency; implemented two link inverse kinematics on Arduino in C++ across five servos.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built an end to end ASR pipeline: 80 channel mel spectrogram encoder, 4 block causal Transformer decoder with cross attention, achieving 15% WER on a Hindi English dataset.
Designed a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython accelerated backend achieving 4 to 5.5x speedup over pure Python, processing 6M characters in 15 minutes.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Implemented distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers with synchronous soma updates on a SLURM managed cluster, modeling neuron level electrical dynamics.
Achieved up to 10.49x speedup with 12 slave processes; identified load imbalance effects causing up to 65% degradation under uneven work distribution.
